extension.description: Lint and formatting for ADVPL/TLPP sources (TOTVS Protheus).
configuration.title: ADVPL Lint
configuration.rules.CA3001.enabled: CA3001 — report include directives that are not lowercase.
configuration.rules.CA3001.severity: Severity shown for CA3001. "default" uses the versioned severity map.
configuration.trace.server: Trace the communication with the language server. Off by default.
configuration.log.level: Log level of the extension. Off by default.
configuration.includePaths: Directories searched for ADVPL/TLPP include files. Used only when neither the TOTVS nor the ADVPL extension provides one. Definable per workspace.
configuration.fixAll.includeRules: Rules that take part in "fix all" and in fix-on-save. A rule left out of this list is still reported; it just is not fixed in bulk.
command.showIncludeSources.title: Show include directories in use
configuration.rules.PJ0001.enabled: PJ0001 — report include references whose case differs from the real file on disk. Requires the include tree to be reachable; check it with "Show include directories in use".
configuration.rules.PJ0001.severity: Severity shown for PJ0001. "default" uses the severity the rule declares (Warning).
